trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.

This structural alignment is validated by the bullish EMA50/200 trend indicators on M15/H4, confirming that any rapid retracement into this zone represents a continuation buy rather than a structural reversal.

Confluence 2: MSNR (Malaysian SNR - SR Flip at 77400), Quarter Theory (QT - 77250 minor quarter level), and Candlestick Patterns (Bullish engulfing on H1 at 11:00) converge to form a strong psychological and structural floor. This is supported by high ATR volatility (223.185 on M15), which ensures that a quick downward wick into this level will be rapidly rejected, forming the defensive staff.

Confluence 3: Fair Value Gap (FVG on M5 between 77240.34 and 77338.22), Candle Range Theory (CRT - defending the lower range of the expansion candle), and Trendline Breaks & Bounces (bounce off the ascending trendline) interact as price seeks to fill the unmitigated gap. This is validated by strong RSI momentum (76.6), indicating that the dip will be aggressively bought before the gap can be fully closed.

Confluence 4: Chart Patterns (Inverse Head and Shoulders breakout neckline at 77400), Supply and Demand (Demand zone mitigation), and ICT / SMC (Liquidity sweep of minor lows) interact to clear out late-joining longs. This is validated by rising OBV and VPVR high volume node support at 77200-77300, showing institutional accumulation at the defensive staff.

Confluence 5: Quarter Theory (77250 level), Break of Structure (BOS), and MSNR (Support level) align with the 0.5-0.618 Fibonacci retracement levels (77134 - 77255) and -2 Standard Deviation band, providing a highly precise defensive staff zone for a tight stop loss.

This resistance has flipped into support (MSNR), aligning with a minor quarter level at 77250, a fresh M5 Fair Value Gap (FVG), and the 0.5-0.618 Fibonacci retracement zone. Momentum (RSI 76.6) and volume indicators support a continuation of the upward expansion, making the buy scenario highly confident at 88.2%.
